newsitem.title: UK: U.K. tax officers meet with LME members.
newsitem.headline: U.K. tax officers meet with LME members.

text.p: Representatives from the Special Compliance Office (SCO) of the U.K. Inland Revenue Service met with members of the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Thursday to discuss tax issues, officials said.
The meeting was held at the London Underwriting Centre in London's financial district this morning.
"I can confirm that a meeting took place. The LME orchestrated a forum for the SCO to address the attendees who were present," LME Chief Executive David King said.
An SCO spokesman said that the meeting was private, But the SCO often hold meetings with professional bodies in order to clarify issues, he said.
King said the meeting concerned SCO interests with regard to tax issues. This area is not confined to LME members, but also concerns other bodies in London's financial community.
Market sources said Inland Revenue had had meetings elsewhere among the London exchanges.
